sentences.text:
11 November, 2024  1 11.11.2024 Item. 14 BR CRR 242 of 2023 Dipankar Barai and Ors.
-vs- The State of West Bengal & anr.

The present revision has been preferred in respect of Kalyani P.S. Case No. 316 of 2019 dated 30.07.2019 under Sections 498A/34 of IPC and Charge Sheet being No. 348 of 2019 dated 31.08.2019 under Section 498A/34 IPC.
None appears on behalf of either sides.
The present revision is disposed of with the direction that the petitioner shall be at liberty to raise the issue raised in the present case before the appropriate forum.
The revisonal application being CRR 242 of 2023 stands disposed of.
All applications connected thereto stand disposed of.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Let a copy of the order be sent to the learned trial Court for compliance.

( Shampa Dutt (Paul), J. )
